idea-plugin.name: Niivue Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Niivue Viewer opens NIfTI medical imaging files (.nii, .nii.gz) directly in your JetBrains IDE.

Powered by Niivue — the same WebGL2 viewer used in the standalone web app and the VSCode extension. Double-click a .nii file in the Project View and it opens in an editor tab with multiplanar slices (axial, coronal, sagittal) plus a 3D render in a 2×2 grid.

Useful for researchers and developers working with neuroimaging or other NIfTI-stored volumes — particularly when you already use Python tooling (nibabel, dipy, ANTs, FSL, nilearn) and want to inspect a volume without leaving the IDE.

Early release. Currently supports .nii and .nii.gz.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Open .nii and .nii.gz files in an editor tab via double-click from the Project View.
  • Multiplanar 2×2 grid layout: axial, coronal, sagittal slices plus an interactive 3D render.
  • HiDPI-aware rendering on Retina and high-DPI displays.
  • Embedded Niivue 0.68.2 (WebGL2). Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion and other JetBrains IDEs.
